outputs.firstPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent PNG sprite atlas for an existing dark fresco FPS. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET, Image2 is original character identity/style reference. Preserve the exact medieval painted identity, earthy sinopia outlines, lime plaster pigment, restrained oxblood/umber/ochre, horrifying mature anatomy, matte Renaissance Inferno fresco rendering. Correct atlas technical defects and animation registration. OUTPUT exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of EIGHT separate fullbody poses, equal cells, no drawn cell borders. TRUE alpha transparency between figures. Every complete figure including every wing, horn, claw, tail must fit INSIDE its own cell with generous EMPTY margin (at least 8% cell width each side and 8% cell height at top/bottom). No figure may cross a cell boundary or overlap a neighbor. No backdrop, floor, cast shadow, captions, text, interface, effects or grids. All eight are same physical character scale, same camera three-quarter front view, fixed anatomical trunk center, consistent lighting; animation via articulated limbs, not changing body proportions. This is for hit-registered game art, so matching head and ribcage landmarks across all poses is essential. Character is the gaunt horned winged goat demon from reference2. Crucial change: current pose2 andpose6 are WRONG: their heads sink near the floor. Replace them with only SHALLOW knee flexion, upright ribcage, head held high. All poses keep skull centered at 60% of cell width and 25% of cell height, ribcage at52% width and43%height, pelvisat50%width63%height. Foot ground baseline at88%height; horns no higher than10%height. In flight leave virtual same88%baseline but tuck feet higher. No deep squat or headlowering. Ordered poses: 1 shallow knee preparation with arms back, 2 knees slightly more bent and wings tensed but skull still HIGH, 3 muscular spring upward arms open and anklesextended, 4 flight legs bent feetraised wingsback, 5 descending legs reaching toward ground claws preparing, 6 landing with SHALLOW bentknees and upright head/ribcage at SAME high landmarks, 7 rising arms recover, 8 poised standingready. Eight visually distinct articulated poses with same cranial height, bodily size and chestcenter. Entirefigureinsideeachcellwithwidegutter.
outputs.finalPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the spacing, arrangement and individual scale of this transparent 8-pose sprite sheet. KEEP ALL EIGHT EXACT PAINTED CHARACTERS AND THEIR EXACT POSES, COLORS AND ANATOMY. Technical atlas correction, not new character art. Every current figure is too crowded. Make EACH INDIVIDUAL CHARACTER approximately 60% of its current drawn dimensions. Arrange the SAME eight characters in precisely EQUAL 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid cells. Their FULL silhouettes now occupy ONLY the CENTRAL60% OF EACH CELL. Each cell must have completely EMPTY transparent margins of at least20%cellwidth and at least15%cellheight. NOTHING crosses a cellboundary; no wings, arms, claws or tails cross toanothercell. HUGE EMPTY GUTTERS are intentional and REQUIRED. Use exactly identical physical scale for ALL eight poses; center skulls on same x coordinate within each cell. Ground line same at80%cellheight; heads at35%cellheight in all poses. Preserve allhandpaintedbrushwork details at smaller size. No new design, no newly exaggerated pose, no background, no floor, no shadow, no lines, no labels, no text. TRUE ALPHA transparent canvas. The atlas is deliberately mostly emptyspace so no limb can be cropped by equal grid slicing.

registration: Manual source-pixel skull, ribcage and virtual ground landmarks in src/render/ability_art.lua. Renderer applies rigid uniform scale/translation to align skull to existing Geometry.volumes; does not change collision data. Integer landmark uncertainty is measured as one source pixel in world units. Full raw measurements in ability-registration-v23.csv.
